subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the public meeting-browser Plugin SDK permanently require full `meetingUrl` input for browser permission plans, with external meeting adapters expected to adopt that contract?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a documented shared Plugin SDK interface rather than only repairing the Teams plugin; the repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction for new or changed plugin API surfaces.

options.title: Approve the required URL contract
options.body: Keep `meetingUrl` required, treat it as the canonical permission-scoping input, and require final compatibility and live-proof evidence before merge.

options.title: Make the contract additive
options.body: Redesign the permission seam so existing external adapters retain a supported migration path while Teams receives the origin-scoping data it needs.

options.title: Keep the scope plugin-local
options.body: Move Teams-specific origin permission handling behind an existing generic seam if maintainers do not want to expand the Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the required URL contract
recommendation.body: Keep `meetingUrl` required, treat it as the canonical permission-scoping input, and require final compatibility and live-proof evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this contributor to both the original Teams adapter and the proposed shared meeting-browser contract evolution.
